text: {"name": "scan_ctrl_update", "confidence": "medium", "docstring": "Updates a scan-control state block by merging pending counters and invoking the interrupt-disabled threshold handler when the accumulated primary count crosses its configured limit.", "subsystem": "wlan", "var_renames": {"v1": "scan_ctrl", "v3": "acc_primary", "v4": "acc_secondary", "v5": "entry_ptr"}, "struct_hints": [{"offset": 33, "meaning": "busy/active accumulation flag"}, {"offset": 16, "meaning": "saved input value passed to the threshold handler"}, {"offset": 24, "meaning": "active entry/buffer pointer; input is stored at pointer+4 when busy"}, {"offset": 8, "meaning": "pending entry/buffer pointer copied to offset 24"}, {"offset": 12, "meaning": "pending primary counter increment added to offset 28"}, {"offset": 28, "meaning": "accumulated primary counter compared against threshold*512"}, {"offset": 4, "meaning": "pending secondary counter increment added to offset 20"}, {"offset": 20, "meaning": "accumulated secondary counter passed to the threshold handler"}]}
